AlertsPage.title: Alerts
AlertsPage.description: Short messages in the flow of the page: tones, links, longer content, dismissing and timers.
AlertsPage.tones_description: Marksheet tones stand in for the Bootstrap colors; red pen is kept for errors.
AlertsPage.links_description: Links inside an alert are bold and underlined in the alert's own color.
AlertsPage.tone_link: {tone} alert with <link>a link to the test results</link>.
AlertsPage.content_description: A title, paragraphs and a rule inside one alert.
AlertsPage.content_body: All marks for the spring term are in. This text runs a little longer so you can see how spacing works inside an alert with more than one paragraph.
AlertsPage.content_footer: Keep blocks inside an alert evenly spaced with the spacing tokens.
AlertsPage.dismissible_description: Close an alert with its icon, its own button or a swipe, then bring both back.
AlertsPage.dismissible_custom_text: Dismissible alert with a custom button.
AlertsPage.auto_description: Both alerts share one countdown and close themselves when it reaches zero.
AlertsPage.countdown_bold: This alert closes in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}…
AlertsPage.countdown_plain: This alert closes in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}…

BadgesPage.title: Badges
BadgesPage.description: Small tracked-caps tags beside headings, inside buttons and as links. Status is never a badge: it is a mark.
BadgesPage.headings_description: A badge scales with the heading it sits in.
BadgesPage.variants_description: The Marksheet variants stand in for the Bootstrap colors.
BadgesPage.pill_description: A stadium border gives the pill shape.
BadgesPage.links_description: As an action chip, a badge answers a tap with a ripple.

ModalsPage.title: Modals
ModalsPage.description: Dialogs on the lifted paper: sizes, a scrolling body, contextual modals and a destructive confirmation, plus the phone’s bottom sheets.
ModalsPage.card_description: Every modal opens centered and closes with the back gesture or a tap outside; the custom one ignores taps outside.
ModalsPage.body: The marks for the spring term are ready to review. Check each result before you share the report card; changes stay a draft until you publish them.
ModalsPage.long_p1: Each test is marked out of 100. A score of 50 or more is a pass; anything below is marked with the red pen and needs a retake.
ModalsPage.long_p2: Pending results are boxed in pencil until the teacher records a score. They do not count towards the totals yet.
ModalsPage.long_p3: Notes are written by hand under the test name. Keep them short: what went well, and one thing to work on next.
ModalsPage.long_p4: Retakes keep the original result on the card and add a new row, so the history of each subject stays visible.
ModalsPage.long_p5: Before publishing, read the card from top to bottom once more. Families see it exactly as it is printed here.
ModalsPage.long_p6: Questions about a mark go to the subject teacher first, then to the head of year if they cannot be settled.
ModalsPage.success_description: Families can now see the spring term report.
ModalsPage.pending_description: Three tests still have no score.
ModalsPage.destructive_description: The Spanish mock exam result will be removed from the report card. This cannot be undone.
ModalsPage.custom_description: A custom header and footer; clicking outside does not close it.
ModalsPage.sheets_description: The phone’s own modal: it slides up from the bottom and closes with a swipe down or a tap above it.

ToasterPage.title: Toasts
ToasterPage.description: Short-lived messages that float over the page, plus a notification from the phone.
ToasterPage.card_description: Set the options, then add as many toasts as you like; each position keeps its own count. Swipe a toast sideways to close it.
ToasterPage.form_title: Add a toast with these options
ToasterPage.toast_body_placeholder: Leave empty for a numbered message
ToasterPage.generated_body: This is toast number {number} in the “{position}” position.
ToasterPage.static_empty: No static toasts. Choose the static position and add one.
ToasterPage.phone_body: Spring term marks are ready to review.
ToasterPage.phone_shown: Notification sent. Pull down the notification shade if it did not pop up.
ToasterPage.phone_scheduled: Notification scheduled: it arrives in 5 seconds, even if you leave the app.
ToasterPage.phone_denied: Notifications are off for this app. Turn them on in the phone’s settings to try again.
ToasterPage.phone_unsupported: This phone cannot show notifications from the app.
ToasterPage.snackbar_description: The phone’s own toast: one at a time at the bottom of the screen, with a mark and a light tap for success and errors.
ToasterPage.snackbar_error_message: The report could not be published.
